svg.title: Lab architecture: EKS with Karpenter across two Availability Zones
svg.desc: An EKS 1.36 cluster in us-east-2 with one managed m5.xlarge worker per Availability Zone in private subnets, a NAT gateway per zone, two Karpenter controller replicas, and a temporary Karpenter-launched m5a.large node that consolidation later removes. EventBridge sends interruption events to an SQS queue read by Karpenter.
